page.overview:
Who is Huaji?

Huaji was a native of Omashu. In 66 BG, he graduated at the top of his class and subsequently joined the local civil service. Over the next three years, his career saw a dramatic rise in the ranks despite his youth. Outwardly, his quick success was based on his skills and eloquence, He created a network of loyal guards, servants and spies to do his bidding.

Early in his career, Huaji discovered that Atka, a young woman, was systematically and effectively exterminating the entire scorpion rat population in Omashu's sewer system. Realizing that she was a master poisoner, he took her into his employment and unleashed her against his rivals and enemies. Atka murdered every target that the official selected, further speeding up his career and causing him to develop a deep trust in his poisoner's abilities. He also amassed great wealth, obtaining a massive and luxurious villa near the top of Omashu's peak.

He eventually became head of one of Omashu's eight departments and Minister of Peace in Queen Guo Xun's cabinet. In the latter position, he was responsible for ensuring cooperation between his own city and the Earth Kingdom capital of Ba Sing Se. Ultimately, Huaji hoped that he would obtain Omashu's throne to rule the city as Jialun's vassal.

In 63 BG, Huaji invited Pushi to his residence in Omashu to inform the older man on the plot's progress. The two initially talked about Pushi's long journey, including his crossing of the Great Divide, and various gossip for several hours.
